# UsageMeter

Usage as Bencho ticks; vermilion past the threshold.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.UsageMeter` · 13 Panels

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.UsageMeter label="…" used={0} limit={0} />
```


## Notes

Usage meter on Bencho ticks (web/src Ticks): off ticks at 55% height in a light ink tint, used ticks rise to full height in ink; past `warnAt` they turn vermilion. The sidebar uses the compact 5h / week card form. @startingPoint section="Panels" subtitle="Tick usage meters" viewport="380x220"
